parole.testo: Borrowed from Sanskrit कर्म (karma, “act, action, deed”), the nominative singular of कर्मन् (karman, “act, action, deed; work”), from कृ (kṛ, “to do, make”) + -मन् (-man, “action/result-forming noun suffix”), ultimately from Proto-Indo-European *kʷer- (“to do, make”).
